details.summary: This is an outstanding, practical, and highly nutritious recipe. It skillfully uses standard supermarket shortcuts (ready-to-eat quinoa) to deliver a well-balanced, plant-forward meal in under 30 minutes, meeting all the chapter's rigorous macronutrient goals perfectly.

dimensions.feedback: The Mediterranean flavors—lemon, tahini, oregano, and garlic—are perfectly balanced and pair wonderfully with the neutral tofu, earthy asparagus, and quinoa base.
All ingredients are fully accounted for in the instructions, and no surprise ingredients are introduced in the text.
The instructions are exemplary: they include clear cook time ranges, mid-point check instructions, and distinct visual doneness cues (e.g., 'golden brown', 'tender-crisp').
The recipe aligns beautifully with the Mediterranean-inspired style, substituting standard Mediterranean proteins with tofu to maintain the structural profile while matching the flavor.
Searing tofu and steaming the asparagus directly in the skillet with a splash of water is a solid, efficient one-pan cooking strategy.
The nutrition values are well-aligned with the quantities provided. The combination of tofu, quinoa, chickpeas, and Greek yogurt plausibly gets the protein near 29g.
The title is highly accurate, and the intro smartly explains the culinary rationale for stretching the tahini with yogurt. The tone fits perfectly.
This is an appetizing, high-protein, vibrant dish. The creamy tahini-yogurt dressing will bring the whole bowl together nicely.
Successfully balances both conditions: it utilizes extra virgin olive oil, relies on robust whole grains and vegetables, and remains lean in saturated fats while providing a quality complex carb.
No added sugars. The carbohydrate presence (50.3g) is superb, originating entirely from whole, fibrous sources like quinoa, chickpeas, and vegetables, hitting the desired window.
Fits the 'Vegetable & Meatless Dinners' intent precisely. It solves the plant-based protein challenge by strategically stacking tofu, beans, grains, and yogurt to exceed the 26g floor.
Easily achieved within 30 minutes from a cold start. Utilizing a ready-to-eat quinoa pouch is a highly practical, book-approved strategy to save time on a weeknight.
